correctness.rationale: The free/fixed positive-definite tridiagonal stiffness has normalized cosine eigenvectors u_jk=sqrt(4/M) cos(pi(2j+1)(2k+1)/(2M)), M=2N+1. Solving stationary scalar damped-oscillator kinetic variance yields Q_kj=u_jk² (the known forward formula). Finite cosine sums imply C1=1/2 1, C²=M/4 I-1/2 J, hence Q²=(I+2J)/M. Thus Q has eigenvalue one in span{1} and eigenvalues of absolute size 1/sqrt M on mean-zero subspace, giving the inverse and exact Euclidean condition number; nonnegative baths are inverse-inequalities. For each row k, modular multiplication by odd m=2k+1 on odd residues mod 2M yields closest residues ±g to zero, giving g maximizing sites; congruence mr=M has (g-1)/2 bath sites when g>1 (perfectly dark), while g=1 gives unique nearest M±2 minimizing site. Linear heat allocation gives extrema and sharp positivity limits. Independent NumPy reconstruction verified Q², inverse geometry and all gcd maxima/minima and multiplicities for every N=2..79, but no claim that finite tests prove all N; original Lyapunov testing inspected as supplied, not independently rerun.

final_claim: For N>=2 equal-mass harmonic mobile sites with free left/fixed right end, positive uniform spring stiffness/damping and independent local Langevin bath temperatures T>=0, the modal kinetic temperature map Theta=QT with Q_kj=2/(2N+1)[1+cos(pi(2k+1)(2j+1)/(2N+1))] has Q²=(I+2J)/(2N+1), inverse T=(2N+1)Q Theta-2(sum Theta)1, condition number sqrt(2N+1), and exactly characterized nonnegative feasible cone. Under total heat budget H>0, each modal max/min and dark-site counts are exact gcd formulas for g=gcd(2k+1,2N+1).
limitations: All equal masses, uniform nearest-neighbor springs and damping, mechanically free/fixed boundaries, nonnegative independent white Langevin reservoirs.
Off-diagonal modal covariances can remain; only diagonal modal kinetic temperatures are inverted.
Min/max for strict positive baths are sharp limits but generally unattained.
